comment: N4OMT is a SAM-dependent O-methyltransferase from Narcissus sp. aff. pseudonarcissus that catalyzes the first committed step in galanthamine and related Amaryllidaceae alkaloid biosynthesis.

changelog.comment: New entry. Rewrote the enzyme description.

reactions.description: N4OMT catalyzes methylation at the 4’-hydroxyl of norbelladine to form 4-O’-methylnorbelladine (4OMN)
The O-methylation in norbelladine affords 4'-O-methylnorbelladine, which is a common intermediate in the biosynthesis of amaryllidaceae alkaloids such as lycorine, galanthamine, and haemanthamine.
